domain: Hospital Facility Management and Navigation System
scenario:
A large hospital network is developing an advanced Facility Management and Navigation System to optimize space utilization, streamline operations, and assist both staff and visitors in navigating complex hospital environments. The system will include detailed floor plans, space allocations, and a digital directory for various facilities such as conference rooms, departments, and waiting areas across multiple buildings.

The system will enable hospital administrators to assign teams to specific areas, manage booking and usage of conference rooms, and ensure that all areas are adequately maintained and monitored. It will also feature a real-time navigation tool for patients and visitors, guiding them to their destinations within the hospital using interactive maps and signage.

Additionally, the system will provide comprehensive reports on space utilization, maintenance schedules, and team assignments. It will facilitate efficient communication and coordination among different hospital departments and support staff. The platform will also incorporate security features to restrict access to sensitive areas and maintain a log of all entries and exits.
